title: Bumblebee waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- wings -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='28' rx='14' ry='10' fill='#A8D8FF' transform='rotate(-20 38 28)'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='24' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#C8E8FF' transform='rotate(10 58 24)'/>
  <!-- wing highlights -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='26' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#E0F2FF' transform='rotate(-20 36 26)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='22' rx='5' ry='3' fill='#E0F2FF' transform='rotate(10 56 22)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#FFD447'/>
  <!-- stripes -->
  <path d='M24 50 Q50 42 76 50 L74 58 Q50 50 26 58 Z' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <path d='M26 66 Q50 58 74 66 L70 74 Q50 66 30 74 Z' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <!-- stripe highlights (lighter edges so they read clearly) -->
  <path d='M26 49 Q50 41 74 49' fill='none' stroke='#6A5A3A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M28 65 Q50 57 72 65' fill='none' stroke='#6A5A3A' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='16' fill='#FFD447'/>
  <!-- fluffy collar -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='46' r='5' fill='#FFE88A'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='46' r='5' fill='#FFE88A'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='50' r='5' fill='#FFE88A'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='50' r='5' fill='#FFE88A'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='5' fill='#FFE88A'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#1A1A40'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#1A1A40'/>
  <circle cx='44.5' cy='36.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='58.5' cy='36.5' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M44 45 Q50 50 56 45' fill='none' stroke='#1A1A40' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M42 26 Q36 16 30 14' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='13' r='3' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <path d='M58 26 Q64 16 70 14' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='13' r='3' fill='#3A2A1A'/>
  <!-- left arm (resting) -->
  <path d='M24 62 Q14 66 12 74' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm waving -->
  <path d='M76 56 Q88 48 88 36' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- waving hand -->
  <circle cx='89' cy='33' r='6' fill='#FFD447'/>
  <!-- little hand highlight -->
  <circle cx='87' cy='31' r='2' fill='#FFE88A'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M50 82 L50 90' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <path d='M38 80 Q34 86 30 86' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 80 Q66 86 70 86' fill='none' stroke='#3A2A1A' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
